items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: And then, uh, come with a job, we had Dougie. Briefly after they had music, they had wine in there. He was at it again, man.

ctx.x: I said, no, I'm a consky man. You are? Man, skinny, skinny isn't me.

What I knew was with him, red face, you know, had a part in the middle, long face. This guy saw him, he got pain again. The lady had to look in the belly, he got fat again, nice brown face, you know? Beautiful home or not. Right off of Metro Road, he had a beautiful home. And then, uh, come with a job, we had Dougie. Briefly after they had music, they had wine in there. He was at it again, man. Then he met up for the broad, and they're boys, they'd be a wine head, you know? They're boys, they're boys, they're…
One of them had a box of cigars. It's a big deal.
